summaryEs: Un cliente ve un cargo que no reconoce en su factura y quiere que lo quiten.

persona.name: Mr. David Reyes
persona.background: Owns a small print shop. Busy, a bit impatient, always pays his bills on time.
persona.mood: confused at first, then frustrated if the agent is vague

goal: Find out why there is an extra $29.99 charge on his bill and get it removed.
hiddenFacts: Account holder name: David Reyes
Account number ends in 4471
Last four digits of his phone number: 3382
The charge is labeled 'Premium Care' and first appeared on September 3
He never asked for Premium Care
He was charged $29.99 again in October, so he wants both charges refunded ($59.98 total)
difficultyNotes: Use common words and a steady pace. If the agent seems lost, repeat the key detail once, more simply.

summaryEs: Una clienta se quedó sin internet y el router tiene una luz roja.

persona.name: Mrs. Linda Parker
persona.background: Retired teacher who uses a laptop at the kitchen table. Not very technical.
persona.speechStyle: very simple words, slow, short sentences

hiddenFacts: Account holder name: Linda Parker
Account number ends in 5520
Address: 14 Maple Street
The internet stopped this morning
The router has a blinking red light
She already unplugged and restarted the router once, with no change
The cables look fine to her
difficultyNotes: Keep every line under 12 words. Never use technical jargon unless the agent uses it first.

summaryEs: Una clienta llama por tercera vez porque su licuadora llegó rota y exige su dinero.

persona.name: Ms. Karen Whitfield
persona.background: Marketing manager, short on time. This is her third call about the same problem.
persona.mood: angry and sarcastic at first; calms down only if the agent shows real empathy and takes ownership
persona.speechStyle: fast and direct, some idioms and sarcasm

goal: Get a full refund to her credit card, not store credit, for a blender that arrived broken.
hiddenFacts: Account name: Karen Whitfield
Order number: 88-5521
Item: Vortex 900 blender, $89.99, bought 12 days ago
The box arrived dented and the jar was cracked
She already called twice and was promised a callback that never happened
She refuses store credit; she wants the money back on her card
She will accept a prepaid return label but not a trip to a store
difficultyNotes: Natural pace, idioms like 'I'm at the end of my rope', may interrupt. Soften only after sincere empathy and a concrete plan.

title.es: Venta de un plan de celular

summaryEs: Un cliente llama por un cargo de datos y podría aceptar un mejor plan si le conviene.

persona.name: Mr. Marcus Allen
persona.background: Sales rep who travels a lot. Careful with money and dislikes contracts.
persona.mood: friendly but skeptical about being sold to

goal: Ask about a data overage fee. He will only agree to a better plan if it clearly saves money and has no contract.
hiddenFacts: Account holder name: Marcus Allen
Phone number ends in 7781
He pays $25 per month for a 5 GB plan
He went over his data twice and paid $10 overage each time
He streams video and uses maps while traveling
He hates long contracts
He would accept an unlimited plan up to $35 per month with no contract
He wants to know if there is a setup fee
difficultyNotes: Ask 'why' questions about the price. Do not accept the first offer; ask about the contract and any fees.

summaryEs: Un cliente quiere saber dónde está su paquete, que ya viene atrasado.

persona.name: Mr. Tom Bennett
persona.background: Bought a birthday gift online and worries it will not arrive in time.

goal: Find out where his package is and when it will arrive.
hiddenFacts: Account holder name: Tom Bennett
Order number: 10432
Ordered on October 1; expected October 5
Item: a pair of running shoes
The tracking page has said 'In transit' since October 3
The birthday is on Saturday
He would like a refund or faster shipping if it will be late
difficultyNotes: Keep every line under 12 words and avoid idioms.

summaryEs: Una reclutadora de RR. HH. le hace una entrevista para un puesto de call center bilingüe.

persona.name: Ms. Elena Torres
persona.background: HR recruiter at Brightline Support, a call center that serves US customers. Professional and warm.
persona.speechStyle: clear, natural pace, open questions one at a time

goal: Decide whether the candidate has the English level, customer-service attitude and reliability for the bilingual agent role.
hiddenFacts: Company: Brightline Support
Role: bilingual (English/Spanish) customer support agent
Schedule: Monday to Friday, 6 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Paid training lasts four weeks
Customers are from the United States, mostly telecom and billing questions
Next step after this interview: a short practical test
difficultyNotes: Natural pace. Ask one follow-up if an answer is vague. Include one situational question, such as handling an angry customer. Near the end, invite the candidate to ask questions.
